name: accounting-dashboard
description: Enterprise accounting SaaS dashboard (Next.js) over the Python/Airtable backend
//: Everything `next build` needs lives in dependencies, NOT devDependencies. Render runs the build with NODE_ENV=production (see render.yaml), which npm reads as --omit=dev, so `npm ci` would skip devDependencies entirely and the build would die on `Cannot find module 'tailwindcss'`. The tailwind/postcss toolchain and the TS type packages are all build-time requirements here.
//overrides: Both entries force a PATCHED copy of a transitive dependency that Next pins below the fixed version; npm audit stays clean only while these are here. postcss: Next pins an exact 8.4.31, below the 8.5.18 that patches GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 / GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q / GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 (8.5.x is semver-compatible with 8.4.x). sharp: Next 15 pulls an optional 0.34.5, below the 0.35.0 that patches the inherited libvips CVEs (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj) -- this app never imports next/image, so sharp is unused weight, but it still lands in the lockfile and still gets flagged.
